title: Electrical Design Engineer – Data Centres
description: **About the Role** ZeroOne is a rapidly growing Dublin-based MEP consultancy specialising in the design of mission-critical data centre infrastructure across Europe. We are looking for Electrical Design Engineers to join our Dublin team. This is an opportunity to develop your career working on some of the most technically challenging electrical engineering problems in the industry, particularly in the areas of power distribution, electrical infrastructure, and mission-critical systems. As chip power densities continue to increase and electrical systems become more sophisticated, the demand for engineers who can develop robust, efficient and resilient electrical designs is growing rapidly. At ZeroOne, you’ll apply your engineering fundamentals to the design of electrical systems for hyperscale, colocation and next-generation AI data centres. You’ll work alongside experienced electrical engineers and founding directors, gaining practical experience across the full design process while developing the technical skills needed to build a successful career in specialist electrical engineering. **What You’ll Be Working On** * Supporting the design and delivery of electrical systems for large-scale data centre projects across the EMEA region. * Developing an understanding of LV and MV power distribution systems, standby generation, UPS systems, transformers, switchgear and other critical electrical infrastructure. * Assisting with electrical engineering calculations, equipment selection, system schematics, single-line diagrams, technical reports and design documentation. * Supporting the development and coordination of electrical designs using industry-standard software. * Developing an understanding of electrical load assessments, cable sizing, voltage drop, fault level calculations, protection and discrimination. * Working with senior engineers to understand how complex electrical systems are designed, analysed, coordinated and delivered. * Assisting with the design of resilient electrical distribution systems for mission-critical environments. * Supporting the development of electrical layouts, containment, busbar, small power, lighting, emergency lighting and other building electrical services. * Collaborating with mechanical engineers, clients and project teams to deliver coordinated, high-quality designs. * Gaining exposure to project meetings, design reviews and site visits across Europe as your experience develops. **About You** We’re particularly interested in candidates who are curious, technically driven and excited by the opportunity to solve complex engineering problems. **Essential:** - Currently completing, or recently completed, a bachelor’s degree or master's in Electrical Engineering or a closely related discipline. - Strong academic grounding in electrical engineering principles and power systems. - A genuine interest in electrical systems, power distribution, and engineering design. - A proactive attitude and willingness to learn. - Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. - Permanent legal right to live and work in Ireland. **Desirable:** - Experience or familiarity with AutoCAD, Revit, Dialux, Amtech or other engineering software. - Base knowledge of LV/MV distribution systems, transformers, generators, UPS systems or data centre electrical infrastructure. - Relevant project, placement, research or university design experience. - An interest in data centres, high-tech facilities or other mission-critical environments. You do not need to have previous data centre experience. We are primarily looking for strong engineering fundamentals, intellectual curiosity and the motivation to develop into an excellent engineer. **About ZeroOne** ZeroOne is a specialist MEP design consultancy focused exclusively on the European data centre sector. Founded in 2025, we have already grown to a team of more than 20 mechanical and electrical engineers, with significant further growth planned. Our Dublin-based team works on projects for some of the world's leading technology companies, hyperscalers, colocation providers and neocloud operators, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, and CoreWeave. Our projects span the EMEA region, with engineers regularly involved in work across continental Europe. Recent project locations have included Copenhagen, Berlin, Amsterdam and the Azores. We combine the technical expertise of an experienced core team with an agile, collaborative approach to project delivery. As a growing consultancy, we offer engineers the opportunity to take on meaningful responsibility early, work closely with experienced engineers and see how their designs contribute to real-world infrastructure. **Why Join ZeroOne?** *Engineer the infrastructure behind AI:* Gain experience in one of the fastest-evolving areas of electrical engineering, from conventional data centre power distribution to the increasingly demanding electrical infrastructure required for high-density AI facilities. *Learn directly from experienced engineers:* Work closely with senior engineers and founding directors who have delivered some of Europe's largest and most complex data centre projects. *Build a strong technical foundation:* Develop practical design skills while applying the engineering principles you studied at university to complex, real-world systems. *International project exposure:* Work on projects across Europe, with opportunities for site visits and exposure to different engineering standards, technologies and project environments. *Grow with the company:* Join a young, ambitious consultancy at an exciting stage of its development, with genuine opportunities to progress as the business grows. *A collaborative, flexible working environment:* Be part of an international team that values technical excellence, learning, initiative and teamwork. **Package & Benefits** - Competitive graduate salary - Pension contribution - Hybrid and flexible working model - 22 days paid annual leave - Structured technical mentoring and professional development - Support towards professional accreditation - Opportunities for international project travel - Regular social outings with our Social Committee **Application** If you’re an electrical engineering graduate or early-career engineer with a strong interest in electrical design, power systems and technically challenging engineering projects, we would love to hear from you.

Create sketches, user flows, wireframes, information architectures, high-fidelity UI designs and interactive prototypes. - Support the end-to-end design process, from initial discovery and concept development through to detailed design and implementation. - Apply interaction design, service design and human-centred design principles to create accessible and effective user experiences. **Research and Prototyping**- Support user research activities to better understand user behaviours, needs and challenges. - Clearly communicate design concepts and decisions through presentations, prototypes and visual storytelling. - Explain and justify design decisions using user insights, business objectives and technical considerations. - Participate in design reviews, contribute constructive feedback and incorporate feedback into your work. - Work within multidisciplinary, agile project teams to support the delivery of high-quality digital products and services. **Innovation and Design Community**- Contribute to a culture of experimentation, collaboration and continuous learning. - Explore how emerging technologies can be applied responsibly to improve user experiences. - Support project planning and delivery activities alongside the wider team. - Represent The Dock's design community through workshops, knowledge-sharing sessions, events and conferences. At The Dock, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside specialists from different disciplines, experiment with emerging technologies and contribute to innovative products and services. Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and familiarity with emerging Generative AI design tools. - A solid understanding of human-centred design, interaction design, user experience principles and rapid prototyping. - Experience contributing to the design of digital products, services or user experiences. - Strong visual communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain design decisions clearly to different audiences. - Ability to collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams, including designers, developers, technical specialists and business stakeholders. - A user-focused and client-oriented approach, with an understanding of how design can deliver meaningful business value. - Ability to receive, provide and incorporate constructive feedback throughout the design process. **Desirable Experience And Skills**- Experience working in agile product development teams, from early-stage concepts through to implementation. - Experience conducting or supporting user research, usability testing and the synthesis of research findings. - Familiarity with accessibility standards and inclusive design best practices. - Experience experimenting with emerging technologies such as Generative AI, conversational AI, voice interfaces or mixed reality. - Ability to develop and communicate conceptual models at both user experience and systems levels. - Understanding of related design disciplines, including Visual Design, Content Design, Service Design and Business Design. - Ability to connect user needs and design solutions with broader business objectives and measurable value. - Interest in innovation, emerging technologies and exploring new approaches to digital interaction. Applications submitted without a portfolio will not be considered. **About Accenture** Accenture helps the world’s leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. title: Sales Associate | J&J MedTech | Surgery | Ireland
description: At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at jnj.com. As guided by Our Credo, Johnson & Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. At Johnson & Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit. **Job Function** Sales Enablement **Job Sub Function** Sales Strategy **Job Category** Professional **All Job Posting Locations:** Dublin, Ireland **Job Description** Role Overview We are seeking a highly motivated Sales Associate to represent the J&J MedTech Surgery Portfolio, with a focus on Wound Closure technologies across an assigned territory in Ireland. This is a customer-facing commercial role with responsibility for driving access, adoption and preference for the J&J MedTech Surgery Portfolio across hospital accounts. The successful candidate will work closely with account managers, commercial colleagues, marketing, professional education and wider J&J MedTech teams to deliver a coordinated approach to account development and customer partnership. The role requires a strong blend of commercial drive, clinical curiosity, customer focus and disciplined execution. You will build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, support education and training activity, develop existing and emerging KOL relationships, and use market intelligence to identify opportunities that grow the business and strengthen J&J Surgery’s position in the market. We are excited to offer an opportunity for a motivated and ambitious individual to join our team as a **Sales Associate within the J&J MedTech Surgery division covering the Dublin region.** This role is the perfect introduction to a career in MedTech sales at Johnson & Johnson, offering hands-on experience, structured development, and exposure to both commercial and strategic aspects of the business. It’s designed to kick-start a long-term career in sales within one of the world’s most respected healthcare companies. **Please note: This role requires a willingness to travel and be flexible regionally to support business needs, training, and project delivery across Ireland.** Key Responsibilities **Sales Support & Development** * Assist in achieving regional sales targets by supporting account activity & customer engagement. * Develop product knowledge and clinical understanding to support in-theatre case coverage and customer queries. * Collaborate with Sales Specialists to identify and pursue new business opportunities. **Customer Engagement** * Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders in hospitals and surgical teams. * Support the planning and execution of customer training events and educational sessions. * Represent the company professionally at all times, upholding our values and commitment to healthcare excellence. **Team Collaboration** * Work closely with the wider sales and support teams to ensure alignment on goals and activities. * Participate in team meetings, training sessions, and development workshops. **Qualifications & Experience** We’re looking for someone who is: * Early in their sales career with a passion for sales, healthcare, or medical technology. * A strong communicator with a proactive, can-do attitude. * Organised, adaptable, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment. * Willing and able to travel across the relevant sales region as required. * Ideally educated to degree level or with equivalent experience in a customer-facing role or healthcare setting. A team player who thrives on collaboration and continuous improvement. Who Are We Looking For? We are looking for a confident, ambitious and highly competitive individual who is also deeply customer centric. The successful candidate will be commercially driven, clinically curious, resilient and motivated by the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in surgical care. * A proven track record of high achievement in medical sales, healthcare, commercial roles or another demanding performance-led environment. Medical sales experience is advantageous but not essential. * A high-impact individual with the interpersonal, communication and influencing skills to move the business forward in a competitive operating theatre environment. * Strong customer focus, with the ability to build strategic partnerships with key stakeholders across hospital accounts. * A solid understanding of the hospital environment, including NHS, HSE and private sector dynamics, or the ability to quickly develop this understanding. * Commercial drive, sound judgement and the ability to identify opportunities, prioritise activity and execute with discipline. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to confidently present complex information in a clear and compelling way. * A collaborative mindset, with a strong affinity for working closely with others across sales, marketing, professional education and commercial teams. * Entrepreneurial behaviour, resilience and the ability to adapt in a fast-moving, competitive healthcare environment. * Degree-level education is desirable. A Business or Science degree would be advantageous but is not essential. What Success Looks Like * The J&J MedTech Wound Closure portfolio is positioned strongly across priority accounts in the assigned territory. * Account plans are clear, actionable and aligned to commercial objectives. * Customer relationships are strengthened through professional engagement, meaningful education and consistent follow-through. * Sales opportunities are identified, progressed and closed with discipline and integrity. * Market intelligence is shared proactively and used to inform local and national strategy. * Internal collaboration across Sales, Marketing, Professional Education and Commercial teams is effective and customer focused. Why Join Johnson & Johnson MedTech Surgery? This is an opportunity to join a world-leading MedTech organisation with a strong surgical heritage and a portfolio that is trusted by healthcare professionals around the world. You will be part of a team that is passionate about advancing surgical care, supporting customers and improving outcomes for patients. You will gain exposure to leading surgical technologies, work with expert colleagues across the UK and Ireland, and build meaningful partnerships with healthcare professionals. For someone with ambition, curiosity and strong commercial capability, this role offers the opportunity to make a visible contribution within a high-performing Surgery business. **What We’re About** At Johnson & Johnson, our culture enables dynamic and impactful careers. We are passionate about our work, care deeply about our customers and communities, and are united by a purpose to profoundly change the trajectory of health for humanity. * Committed to caring. * Responsible to our communities. * Ready to apply our knowledge and know-how. * Strengthened by different backgrounds and experiences. * The drivers of our own success. * Passionate about doing what is right. Make a Unique Mark in Your Career If you want to be recognised for the talent you bring, be the driver of your own career and work with others who share your passion for caring, innovation and success, we would welcome your application. Join Johnson & Johnson MedTech Surgery and help us continue to advance surgical care for patients, healthcare professionals and communities across Ireland. **Required Skills** **Preferred Skills:** **The Anticipated Base Pay Range For This Position Is** €43,100.00 - €69,000.00 **Benefits** In addition to base pay, we offer the following benefits\*: an annual bonus with set target (% of pay) depending on pay grade / location, where the actual amount is based on the employees’ and companies’ performance of the previous calendar year, or sales commissions. Moreover, we offer vacation days, parental leave for a minimum of 12 weeks, bereavement leave, caregiver leave, volunteer leave, well-being reimbursement, programs for financial, physical and mental health. We also offer service anniversary and recognition awards, and subject to the terms of their respective plans, employees - and in some location’s eligible dependents - can participate in several insurance plans. For more information, visit Employee benefits | Supporting well-being & career growth | Johnson & Johnson Careers. * This is for informative purposes only. Amounts and actual benefits may vary by location and are subject to change.

The role involves ownership of support tickets, adhering to SLAs, troubleshooting hardware and software, performing system security checks and backups, and providing occasional technical training. **Role & Responsibilities:** * Take full ownership and responsibility for allocated support tickets ensuring prompt and professional resolution. * Adhere strictly to SLAs when handling customer routine system security checks, backups, and produce status reports. * Collaborate with other technical staff to ensure system connectivity and compatibility. * Maintain hardware and software inventories, licensing, user access, and security records. * Provide technical training occasionally to system administrators and end-users. * Maintain confidentiality of processed, stored, or accessed information. * Fulfil various ad hoc duties as required. **Skills, Qualifications & Experience:** * IT qualifications desirable. * Previous experience in a service desk role. * Effective communication and people skills. * Proficiency in documented technical skills including Microsoft Operating Systems, Microsoft Applications, and antivirus/spyware/malware applications. * Familiarity with industry-standard troubleshooting procedures and Active Directory. **Experience:** * Demonstrated experience in first line technical support. * Handling and resolving service desk tickets with SLA adherence. * Experience with IT hardware and software installation and troubleshooting. **Education & Certifications:** * Relevant IT qualifications are desirable. * Certifications in Microsoft technologies or IT service management are advantageous. **Visa:** * Irish/EU Citizen or Stamp 4 Visa holder. **About Us** As Ireland's largest IT Solutions Provider with a growing global footprint, Presidio (previously Ergo) offers deep expertise across managed IT & hardware services, cloud, applications & software services, IT resourcing, and modern work solutions. Our recent technology awards reflect our commitment to delivering industry-leading IT solutions, highlighting our team's dedication and expertise.

title: Services - Summer Analyst, Ireland - Dublin, 2027
description: **You're the brains behind our work.** You’re ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the workplace, and Citi wants to help you get there. Whether it’s honing your skills or building your network, we know that success comes with growth. Our program equips you with the knowledge and training you need to play a valuable role on your team and establish a long-term career here. At Citi, we value internal mobility—career growth is not a question of if, but when. **What is Services?** Citi’s Services organization plays a crucial role in supporting institutional clients through a wide range of innovative solutions, enabling them to navigate complex financial landscapes. Our business provides integrated cash management and trade finance solutions to help multinational corporations, financial institutions, and public sector organizations optimize liquidity, working capital, and streamline transactions globally. Our business also delivers custody, fund administration, collateral management, and performance analytics, helping asset managers, institutional investors, and financial institutions efficiently manage and safeguard assets. With our global reach, including presence in over 90 countries, cutting-edge technology, and client-first approach, we provide seamless solutions that drive business success in an evolving financial world. In this rapidly evolving landscape, we are increasingly leveraging advanced analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance our offerings, improve efficiency, and provide deeper insights to our clients. This includes utilizing AI-powered tools for predictive analytics, automation of routine tasks, and generating actionable insights from vast datasets to inform strategic decisions across our services portfolio. **We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.** The Citi Services 10-week Summer Analyst Program gives entry-level employees hands-on experience through training sessions and real, on-the-job learning. Summer Analysts work closely with their teams, owning projects that drive meaningful impact. After an initial week of training and a placement process based on your interests and our needs, you’ll be assigned to a team where you’ll focus on financial analysis, business development, client engagement, and market research. **Your time here will look something like this:** * Conduct market research to assess industry trends and the impact of macroeconomic factors. * Develop materials that support business development, product commercialization, and revenue growth, identifying opportunities where data-driven insights and AI capabilities can add value. This may involve contributing to business cases for new AI-driven product features or improvements to existing services. * Assist with process optimization initiatives to enhance efficiency and mitigate risk, potentially exploring how AI/ML tools can automate tasks or improve decision-making. Evaluate the effectiveness of AI-powered automation in improving operational workflows and reducing manual effort. * Analyze client data to identify opportunities and improve service offerings, leveraging various analytical techniques, including interpreting insights derived from advanced analytical models. You will be exposed to how AI models are used to segment clients, predict behaviors, and personalize service delivery. * Prepare reports and presentations for internal stakeholders and senior leadership, effectively communicating complex data analysis and potentially insights from AI-driven tools. Clearly articulate the implications and benefits of AI-generated insights for business strategies. * Participate in networking events, training sessions, and leadership discussions to strengthen your personal and professional development. **We want to hear from you if…** * You are a university student graduating in Summer 2028, and on track to achieve a 2.1(or equivalent) * You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * You are proficient in Microsoft Excel (e.g., data analysis, lookups, basic modeling) and have working knowledge of PowerPoint and Outlook. Exposure to analytical platforms or an eagerness to learn about AI-specific tools (e.g., natural language processing applications, machine learning dashboards) will be beneficial. * You have an interest in financial services and a drive to learn how technology, including AI, is transforming the industry. Demonstrated curiosity about how AI is being leveraged for efficiency, client experience, and risk management is key. **Who We Think Will Be a Great Fit…** We’re looking for motivated individuals who are eager to start their careers at a global organization, tend to think strategically, have an innovative approach to business, and value diversity as much as we do. We know that anyone—not just those with business degrees—can have a knack for business, so we’re open to all disciplines. We’ll also be looking for: * Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills. * Excellent communication skills. * A high level of accuracy, time management, and attention to detail, including a proactive interest in understanding AI methodologies and their application in real-world business scenarios. * Solid organizational skills and ability to work autonomously – self-starter. * A high level of personal integrity, commitment to excellence, and a strong desire to learn. * Resilience to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. * A sense of urgency and the ability to execute quickly and efficiently. **Your future at Citi** Successful Summer Analysts may be invited to return as full-time Analysts upon graduation. During the program, you will have access to mentorship, career development sessions, and networking opportunities with senior leaders and professionals across Citi. This experience is designed to provide you with a strong foundation to launch a long-term career within the firm, preparing you for a future where technology and AI play an increasingly central role. You will develop skills that are not only relevant today but are also essential for navigating the evolving landscape of AI-driven financial services. Join us and take the first step toward shaping the future of Citi! ------------------------------------------------------ **Job Family Group:** Product Management and Development ------------------------------------------------------ **Job Family:** Market Segments and Services ------------------------------------------------------ **Time Type:** Full time ------------------------------------------------------ **Primary Location Full Time Salary Range:** €0.00 - €2,250,000.00 ------------------------------------------------------ **Most Relevant Skills** Please see the requirements listed above. ------------------------------------------------------ **Other Relevant Skills** For complementary skills, please see above and/or contact the recruiter. ------------------------------------------------------ *Citi is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified candidates will receive consideration without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by law.* *If you are a person with a disability and need a reasonable accommodation to use our search tools and/or apply for a career opportunity review* *Accessibility at Citi.* *View Citi’s EEO Policy Statement and the Know Your Rights poster.*

title: Software Development Engineer, Firecracker

title: Software Engineer Train AI (Mid-Level)
description: **About RWS** RWS is a global leader in content, translation, and intellectual property services. With more than 60 years of experience, RWS helps the world’s top brands grow by ensuring they are understood anywhere, in any language. The company combines proprietary technology with deep human expertise to deliver high-quality, compliant, and scalable solutions across industries such as life sciences, technology, finance, and legal. **About Train AI** Training or fine-tuning artificial intelligence (AI) requires data. LOTS of data. However, not just any data will do – our clients need responsible AI data that’s targeted, accurate and reliable to ensure machine learning (ML) success. But preparing AI training data is a monumental task that can take up the vast majority of AI project time, leaving AI teams with precious little time to focus on developing, deploying and evaluating ML models. TrainAI by RWS helps our clients address this challenge head-on. With a seamless blend of technological understanding and human intelligence, TrainAI provides complete, end-to-end data collection and content generation, data annotation or labelling, human-in-the-loop data validation and generative AI data services for all types of AI, in any language, at any scale, based on the principles of responsible AI. Today, TrainAI supports four of the world’s top five technology companies, enhancing the performance of their generative AI by providing services such as prompt engineering, response refinement and red teaming with locale-specific domain experts across a broad range of topic areas and educational levels. **Job Purpose** We’re looking for a mid-level product focused engineer to join our team. You'll own features and small products end-to-end—design, build, ship, iterate—using AI tools as your primary means of execution. You’ll be working with AI agents but bringing your own product judgment to every decision. We move fast because AI multiplies what one engineer can do, and this role is built for that. **Job Overview** **Responsibilities:** * Own features across the full lifecycle: scope the problem, prototype, ship to production, and iterate on feedback Use AI coding agents as your default workflow - delegating implementation, reviewing and directing output, and going from idea to working software quickly * Turn product goals into technical decisions without waiting for a fully detailed spec * Work across the stack (backend, frontend, and often design/UX) as the problem requires * Collaborate with senior engineers and product to sharpen your product and technical instincts **Requirements:** * 2–4 years of software engineering experience with solid fundamentals - you can read, evaluate, and debug code you didn't write line-by-line * Hands-on experience with AI development tools, or strong evidence you'll pick them up fast * Emerging product sense: you care about the user problem and can form opinions about what to build * Comfort with ambiguity and ownership—you'd rather ship and learn than wait for perfect requirements * Ability to work across at least a couple of areas of the stack * Bias toward action and rapid iteration **Nice to have:** * Experience on a small team or shipping something you scoped yourself * Familiarity with prompt engineering, evals, or AI-powered features * Some design or product exposure beyond pure engineering # **Why Is This Role Different?** * You're not inheriting a backlog, you're owning a product area with real scope and real stakes. The engineering team you'll work with ships fast using agentic tooling as their default; you're expected to match that pace in how you work too, not just in what you ask for. **Life at RWS** **Life at RWS** **-** If you like the idea of working with smart people who are passionate about growing the value of ideas, data and content by making sure organizations are understood , then you’ll love life at RWS. Our purpose is to unlock global understanding. This means our work fundamentally recognizes the value of every language and culture. So, we celebrate difference, we are inclusive and believe that diversity makes us strong. We want every employee to grow as an individual and excel in their career. In return, we expect all our people to live by the values that unite us: **to partner** , putting clients fist and winning together **, to pioneer** , innovating fearlessly and leading with vision and courage, **to progress** , aiming high and growing through actions and **to deliver** , owning the outcome and building trust with our colleagues and clients. **RWS embraces DEI** and promotes equal opportunity, we are an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind. RWS is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at RWS are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, religion, nationality, ethnicity, sex, age, disability, or sexual orientation. RWS will not tolerate discrimination based on any of these characteristics. **RWS Values** Get the 3Ps right – Partner, Pioneer, Progress – and we´ll Deliver together as RWS. **Recruitment Agencies:** RWS Holdings PLC does not accept agency resumes. title: Technical Implementation Specialist
description: **About Portside** Portside is a leading provider of cloud-based software solutions for the global aviation industry. Our platform powers critical operations across business aviation, regional airlines, and aircraft leasing & finance, helping over 1,000 aviation organizations streamline operations, improve decision-making, and operate more efficiently. Backed by leading technology investors Vista Equity Partners and Insight Partners, Portside is entering an exciting phase of growth. We are expanding our platform, investing in AI driven innovation, and building a global team focused on shaping the future of aviation technology. **Job Summary** Portside provides the software platform (CRM and Asset Management, built on Salesforce and the LeaseWorks product) that aircraft leasing companies use to run their commercial and technical operations. The Technical Implementation Specialist is the aviation technical expert embedded in our Professional Services team: someone who already thinks like an aircraft technical specialist — comfortable with maintenance records, airworthiness compliance, LLP tracking, and maintenance reserves — and now applies that expertise to loading, validating, and structuring customer technical data inside our platform during implementation. This person is the trusted technical counterpart to each customer's own Technical Specialists, gathering their asset data, resolving discrepancies, and translating aviation domain knowledge into a clean, working configuration. No prior software or Salesforce experience is required; we will train the right aviation background into our tools. **Key Responsibilities** * Act as the primary technical data point of contact during customer implementations, working directly with the customer's Technical Specialists and Asset Managers to gather aircraft and engine technical data (maintenance status, AD/SB compliance, LLP tracking, maintenance reserves, technical lease provisions). * Own the loading, mapping, and validation of customer technical data into the Salesforce and LeaseWorks (Aeris Asset) product modules for each implementation. * Design data mapping between customers' legacy systems (spreadsheets, prior systems of record, records databases) and LeaseWorks' data model, in coordination with the implementation and engineering teams. * Perform quality assurance and reconciliation on loaded data, verifying accuracy and completeness against source technical records before go-live. * Identify data gaps, inconsistencies, or quality issues in customer records and work with client-side technical teams to resolve them within the agreed implementation schedule. * Support scoping conversations by advising on data readiness, required source materials, and realistic timelines for technical data loads. * Serve as a translator between aviation technical concepts and internal implementation, engineering, and support teams who may not have an aviation background. * Document data mapping decisions, local customizations, and data load procedures, and hand these off cleanly to the Support/CS team for ongoing maintenance. * Develop and maintain working proficiency in Salesforce and LeaseWorks configuration as it relates to technical and asset data structures. * Feed real implementation experience back to Product and Engineering to flag data model gaps or opportunities for better out-of-the-box standardization. * Support training of customer technical stakeholders on how to maintain and update their data within the platform after go-live. * Participate in ideation and configuration sessions with customer cross-functional teams during implementation. **Qualifications** * Background in aircraft technical records, continuing airworthiness, maintenance management, or aircraft leasing technical/asset management — e.g., prior experience as a Technical Specialist, Technical Records Specialist, or similar role at an airline, MRO, or leasing company. * Strong working knowledge of aircraft technical documentation: AD/SB compliance, LLP tracking, maintenance programs, delivery/redelivery conditions, and maintenance reserves. * No prior SaaS, Salesforce, or LeaseWorks experience required — but a genuine willingness and aptitude to learn new software systems; training will be provided. * Comfortable working with structured data sets: cleaning, mapping, and validating data in Excel or similar tools. * Excellent communication skills, able to translate technical aviation concepts for a software audience and software/process concepts for aviation-side customer contacts. * Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage data workstreams across multiple concurrent customer implementations. * Prior client-facing or implementation/onboarding experience is a plus, but not required. **What We Offer** * Competitive base salary * Fully remote work * Generous time off policy * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Opportunities for professional development and career advancement. * Dynamic, collaborative, and fast-growing work environment. Portside is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Technology & Data Innovation Graduate Pathways
description: **Job Description** Step into the heart of innovation at the daa by joining our Technology & Data Innovation Graduate Programme. You will work alongside experienced professionals to tackle real business challenges that keep Ireland’s airports running smoothly, delivering innovative solutions across key areas including operations, retail, digital, commercial, and corporate functions. Graduates will join the Early Careers Community, a network of interns, apprentices, and second-year graduates, offering opportunities to learn, collaborate, and build professional connections across the business. Based on your skills, experience and area of interest, you will join either our Technology Team or our Data Team within daa Labs on a two-year fixed-term contract. From day one, you will be embedded within your specialist team and remain there for the duration of your contract, allowing you to develop deep expertise, take ownership of meaningful projects, and make a lasting impact. **Technology Team** Gain hands-on experience across a range of technology disciplines, including cloud platforms, application development, automation, DevOps, networking, and enterprise systems. By working on live projects, you will help design, deliver, and support technology solutions that enhance efficiency, strengthen resilience, and drive innovation across the business. **Data Team** You will work with stakeholders across the organisation to develop dashboards, analytics tools, data models, and applications that enable smarter decision-making. You'll gain exposure to modern data platforms and engineering practices while helping transform complex data into actionable insights. **Responsibilities** **As a Technology Innovation Graduate, and dependent on your specialism you will gain exposure to:** * Developing apps, integrations and digital tools * Building automation pipelines and configure cloud/on-premises infrastructure * Supporting networking, integration and IT service delivery * Prototyping data-driven solutions with business teams * Working on real-time systems that keep airport operations running 24/7 **As a Data Innovation Graduate, and dependent on your specialism you will gain exposure to:** * Designing dashboards, reports and data products * Building cloud-based data pipelines and integrations * Developing models and prototypes to solve business challenges * Analyzing processes and uncover insights through data * Collaborating with teams across operations, retail and innovation * Supporting scalable, data-driven solutions **Qualifications** **Do you have what it takes?** **Role** We’re looking for curious minds and bold thinkers ready to shape the future of airport technology. To thrive in this role, you should: * Hold (or be expecting) a 2.1 degree or higher in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Product Design, or related disciplines. * Demonstrate adaptability, responding positively to change and thriving in dynamic and evolving environments. * Show an innovative mindset, seeking opportunities to improve processes, challenge conventional thinking, and solve problems creatively. * Apply critical thinking, using evidence, insight, and sound judgement to make informed decisions. * Exhibit learning agility, learning quickly, embracing feedback, and continuously developing new skills and capabilities. * Be strong collaborators, building effective relationships and working successfully across teams and stakeholders to achieve shared goals. * Align with daa's values and purpose, sharing our commitment to enabling business, connecting lives, and building a sustainable future. **What We Are Offering You?** As a daa Technology & Data Innovation Graduate, you will enjoy a comprehensive package of benefits designed to support your growth and reward your performance. Depending on your specialism, you will also have access to a tailored range of technical and professional development opportunities. **Benefits Include** * Competitive salary with a performance-related bonus. * Tailored technical and professional development based on your specialism. * Opportunities to achieve certifications in Microsoft Azure, Power BI and Databricks. * Development of data and analytics skills across SQL, Python, PySpark, cloud architecture, and data engineering. * Training in Agile delivery, stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration. * Exposure to projects across daa, including Airfield Operations, Airport Operations, Retail, and Commercial eCommerce. * Experience working with modern technologies such as Azure, DevOps, GitHub, Jira, Databricks, Oracle, SQL databases, Red Hat OpenShift, and enterprise systems.

title: Trainee Buyer – Placement Student
description: **Company Description** **Trainee Buyer — Student Placement Year** **Because you’ll make the difference** Ready to own your career in an ever-growing fashion hub? Then take on a Primark placement starting in Summer 2027. This is your chance to grab valuable experience in a global company that truly feels like a family. You’ll have real projects with real autonomy. You’ll get to know incredible experts who make our fashion a reality. And you’ll gain off-the-scale exposure, making a huge impact for our customers and your future. Want it? Then own it on our undergraduate placement programme. **Because you matter** People are at the heart of what we do, so it’s essential that we provide you with the right environment to perform at your very best. We offer benefits that put you first: * **Pay rate**: Generous EUR 30,000 salary * **Development**: A 12 month development programme which kicks off with our Freshers Week * **Balance**: Our ‘Your Day, Your Way’ approach means you can finish up at 2pm every Friday if you’ve done your 37.5 hours that week * **Discounts**: Use your in-store colleague discount across our fabulous range * **Support**: Explore our well-being initiatives and Employee Assistance Programme, Let’s Talk. As well as mentorship to get the most out of your year * **Holiday**: Enjoy 27 days holiday on top of the Bank Holidays And if you need to relocate to Dublin for the role: * We’ll support you with opening a bank account and registering for tax and social security in Ireland. * Not sure where to live? Primark will help with finding accommodation for the year. **About you** If you’re an undergraduate looking for a 12 month placement before you head back to university for your final year, we’d love to hear from you. If you’re in your last year at university or have already graduated, head back to the careers website to find other roles across the business. **Job Description** **What you’ll need** You’ll be a great communicator with a passion for fashion, a unique interest in products and trends, and a strong awareness of the industry — especially what’s happening on the high street, catwalks and on social. You won’t be short of initiative either. In fact, you’ll be happy to handle your own workload with the support of others. If you’re studying Fashion Buying, Fashion Design or a Commercial-based degree, the Primark placement in Buying is the perfect fit for you. **What you’ll do** After your induction, you’ll dive right in! You’ll learn about the department by doing real work with your teams on tasks and projects. A store placement will teach you how stock moves and departments are laid out — and give you a feel for the customer experience that you can only get by being there. With all this great prep, you’ll be able to take on real responsibility from day one! You’ll strengthen relationships and share your ideas at team meetings, grow what you know at masterclasses, and have regular catch ups with your assigned buddy and line manager to support your development. So when you present to your Director at the end of your placement, you won’t be short of things to say. **Qualifications** **Why should you apply?** In Primark, we’ve always said everyone’s invited and we’re committed to making everyone feel safe and comfortable to be themselves. We believe that a diverse, inclusive, and accessible environment elevates us all, and enables creative ideas and collaboration to flourish. Because when we work together, we can accomplish so much more. And yes, this place moves fast, and it’s growing even faster but we’re committed to providing the best, and most socially and environmentally ethical fashion that’s affordable for everyone. Primark Cares is our commitment to reducing fashion waste, halving our carbon footprint, and improving the lives of the people who make our products. This placement has real impact, you could even see the results of your work, out on the shop floor! Make your CV look amazing and if you wow us, there could be a permanent job up for grabs when you graduate. **Isn’t it time you put theory into practice? We think so. Apply now for a Primark placement and start owning your journey.** **Additional Information** **About the placement** You don’t watch from the sidelines around here — you get stuck in. Through hands-on experience and responsibility from the get-go, you’ll gain a vast insight into how our business works and contribute to it from day one. Inspiring, supportive colleagues will make you feel welcome and valued. And we’ll also help you to develop your skill set and grow your potential through supported learning with on-the-job training, masterclasses, and an assigned buddy. **Before applying, please ensure that if you are offered a place on the programme, it has been approved by your university or educational institution.** **Closing date: Friday, 6th November 2026. We reserve the right to close the application window early should we receive sufficient applications**

Make your CV look amazing and if you wow us, there could be a permanent job up for grabs when you graduate. **Isn’t it time you put theory into practice? We think so. Apply now for a Primark placement and start owning your journey.** **Additional Information** **About the placement** You don’t watch from the sidelines around here — you get stuck in. Through hands-on experience and responsibility from the get-go, you’ll gain a vast insight into how our business works and contribute to it from day one. Inspiring, supportive colleagues will make you feel welcome and valued. And we’ll also help you to develop your skill set and grow your potential through supported learning with on-the-job training, masterclasses, and an assigned buddy. **Before applying, please ensure that i****f you are offered a place on the programme, it has been approved by your university or educational institution.** **Closing date: Friday, 6th November 2026.
